matchRule: matched = both engines succeed, every spice-ts analysis has an ngspice counterpart, and for every common signal max|spice-ts - ngspice| <= 0.01 x max(peak |ngspice signal|, floor). The floor is uniform per quantity (#593): 0.0001 V for node voltages v(...) and 1e-10 A for branch currents i(...), so a signal whose ngspice peak is zero or tiny matches when the absolute difference is at most the ngspice-47 default VNTOL (0.000001 V) or ABSTOL (1e-12 A); every other quantity (pole/zero roots, noise spectra) keeps 1e-12. Deck .options tolerances are not consulted. Errors are taken at spice-ts points with ngspice interpolated (transient breakpoint alignment as in the aggregate report).
runtimeNote: Median of three cold process wall times including adapter and startup; not solver-only or browser performance.
